build_image_matting_model: build a ViTMatte model for image matting that produces alpha matte predictions from input images
create_conv_stream_features: create a convolution stream that extracts detail feature maps from input pixel values

init_conv_batchnorm_weights: initialize weights for convolution and batch normalization layers in the ViTMatte model
